title: Home Page Redesign, 2-Column Product Grid, Sticky Bottom Nav & WhatsApp Help Button

requirements.text: Redesign the HomePage layout so that: (1) a compact auto-sliding banner carousel appears at the very top (reduce banner height to approximately 140–160px on mobile), (2) the ProductGrid appears immediately below the banner with no intervening sections, and (3) the MobileRechargeSection is relocated to the bottom of the page as a compact icon-based grid or small card (e.g., a row of operator icons with a label), above the footer.

quotes: Move the Mobile Recharge section to a small icon-based grid or a small card at the bottom
The top should have one sliding banner for offers, and Products must start appearing immediately after that
Decrease the height of the banners

acceptanceCriteria: The homepage renders a horizontally auto-sliding banner carousel at the very top with a height of roughly 140–160px on mobile screens.
Product grid starts rendering immediately after the banner — no full-width sections interrupt between banner and products.
The Mobile Recharge section is displayed near the bottom of the page as a compact icon-grid card (small operator icons + label), not as a full-width form section.
No layout regression on the ShopClosedBanner, CategoryFilter, or CartDrawer components.

requirements.text: Redesign the product display in ProductGrid to use a strict 2-column grid layout. Each ProductCard must display: a clean product image, the product name in bold, a green 'Delivery in 10 Mins' tag, and a prominent green '+ ADD' button. When no products are found (empty state), render a visually appealing 'Coming Soon' graphic/illustration with descriptive text instead of plain text.

quotes: Change the product display to a 2-column Grid Layout
A clean image. Product name in bold. The 'Delivery in 10 Mins' green tag. A very prominent '+ ADD' button in green color.
If no products are found, show a beautiful 'Coming Soon' graphic instead of plain text

acceptanceCriteria: ProductGrid renders exactly 2 columns on mobile and tablet viewports.
Each product card shows: product image (clean, object-cover), product name in font-bold, a green badge reading 'Delivery in 10 Mins', and a green '+ ADD' button that is visually prominent.
When the product list is empty (after filtering or initially), a styled 'Coming Soon' empty state with an illustration/graphic is rendered instead of plain text.
The '+ ADD' button is disabled when the shop is closed (existing behavior preserved).

requirements.text: Add a Sticky Bottom Navigation Bar fixed to the bottom of the viewport with 4 navigation items: Home, Search, My Orders, and Wallet — each with an appropriate icon and label. The bar must appear on all customer-facing pages. Also add a small floating WhatsApp Help button (WhatsApp green, bottom-right corner) that opens a WhatsApp chat link when tapped. Ensure the sticky nav does not overlap page content (add appropriate bottom padding to page layouts).

quotes: Add a Sticky Bottom Navigation Bar with 4 icons: Home, Search, My Orders, and Wallet
add a small floating 'WhatsApp Help' button on the bottom right

acceptanceCriteria: A sticky bottom nav bar is rendered fixed at the bottom with 4 tabs: Home, Search, My Orders, Wallet — each with an icon and text label.
Active tab is visually highlighted (e.g., green color).
A floating WhatsApp button (green circular FAB) is visible at the bottom-right, above the sticky nav, and opens a WhatsApp chat URL on tap.
Page content is padded at the bottom so it is not obscured by the sticky nav bar.
The sticky nav is not shown on admin pages (AdminPage, AdminSettingsPage, BillingPage).

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
Preserve all existing backend logic — no backend changes required.
The MobileRechargeSection component logic (form, mutation hook) must be preserved; only its placement and visual wrapper change.
Shop closed state behavior and CartDrawer must remain fully functional.
nonGoals: No backend schema or API changes.
No changes to admin pages layout or admin navigation.
No changes to the checkout, order confirmation, or billing flows.
No new backend features (Search, Wallet functionality are nav placeholders only — no full implementation required).
No changes to Internet Identity authentication flow.

required: Colorful 'Coming Soon' illustration with stars and a shopping basket on a light background, suitable for an empty product grid state (coming-soon.dim_400x300.png)
